label: NLR-like bNACHT system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses an NLR-related bacterial NACHT locus represented by DefenseFinder as an NLR_like_bNACHT01 or NLR_like_bNACHT09 single-profile model, encoding a NACHT-module STAND-family protein that can restrict bacteriophage production.
observations: NLR-like bNACHT branch under phage defense system; distinct from animal nucleotide-binding domain and leucine-rich repeat-containing proteins, individual bacterial NACHT genes or proteins, the broad DefenseFinder NLR key, the individual NLR_like_bNACHT01 and NLR_like_bNACHT09 HMM profiles, CARD-NLR detector systems, Rst TIR-NLR loci, bNACHT effector activities, and other phage-defense systems.
